scope: Candidate correspondence only; no clinical inference or model training

method.distance: Euclidean distance to foreground pixel centers, bilinear sampled; approximate, not exact continuous-mask distance
method.candidate_gate: min mask distance / tooth bbox diagonal <= 0.15
method.calibration: Heuristic thresholds, not calibrated probabilities or anatomical validation
method.identity: Split + image ID + original mask filename; bone line ID is zero-based source array index; no FDI assignment
